next_step.guide: Before the blending game, let the learner teach you one thing about a dinosaur, then model one blend slowly-then-fast and hand it straight back.
next_step.learner: Push the three sounds in a short dinosaur name together until the whole name pops out, then say it once more at speed.

reach.alone: Says each single letter sound correctly and names many dinosaurs on sight.
reach.with_help: Blends three sounds into a short word when the sounds are modelled slowly first and the word is one they want to say.
reach.not_yet: Holding five sound-chunks together in a long name without a model; keep the long names as a place to play, not a place to test.

signals.watch: covering the page or turning away
signals.looks_like: a hand over the screen or a turned shoulder, usually after about two misses in a row
signals.not: not evidence of a reading disorder; it is this learner telling you the pressure just crossed their line

then.detail: The guide moves in to do the sounds together, not to ask why or wait it out.

signals.watch: answering from the first sound only
signals.looks_like: picks a word that merely starts with the first sound instead of blending the whole chain
signals.not: not a sign of guessing or laziness; it is a learner anchoring on the one sound they are sure of

then.detail: Offer the slow-then-fast model for that exact chain once, then step back.

signals.looks_like: explains a dinosaur difference unprompted and at length before the work begins
signals.not: not a measure of ability or reading level; it is a confidence door that is open right now

then.detail: Note that the session started from confidence, so the guide can protect that opening next time.

companion_may.offer: Model a single blend: say the sounds slowly, then faster, until the word emerges, using a name the learner chose.
companion_may.when: the learner stalls on one chain and has not covered the page
companion_may.ceiling: Model once and hand back; never read the word for them more than once, and never run a streak of blends without the guide present.

companion_may.offer: Pick the next name from the learner's own dinosaurs so the chunks feel earned, not drilled.
companion_may.when: choosing the next item at the learner's current level
companion_may.ceiling: Suggest, never insist; the guide or learner picks the final name.

guide_only.reserved: Reading the learner's face a moment before the page gets covered and deciding to move in.
guide_only.why: The pre-frustration tell is in the body, not in the answer stream the companion sees.

guide_only.reserved: Deciding to stop the session on a small success even with questions left.
guide_only.why: Ending well is a judgement about this child today; a completion target would override it.

guide_only.reserved: Tying a specific name the learner mentioned in conversation to the sounds of this session.
guide_only.why: It depends on what was said in the room, which is the guide's to hear and use.

techniques.move: Blend with a name the learner wants to say: sound it slowly, compress to speed, let the wanted word pull the sounds together.
techniques.concept: blending single sounds into a whole word
techniques.stuck_signature: produces each sound cleanly in isolation but the sounds stay separate and the learner says a different word starting with the first sound

services.for: hearing whether the learner actually joined the sounds aloud, since blending lives in sound and the written quiz cannot carry it
services.boundary: Report what was heard as a blend-or-not behaviour; never keep the audio and never score the child.
services.offline_fallback: The guide listens and judges the blend; the game records only the chosen answer.

services.for: letting the learner hear a modelled name when the guide is not beside them
services.boundary: Model only; never replace the learner's own attempt to blend.

bundle.does: Carries one session's game and the next-step pair; the guide runs it in a short burst and the game records which chains broke down for next time.
bundle.cannot: Cannot hear whether a sound was blended aloud, cannot notice the page being covered, and cannot catch the good moment to stop — all of that waits on the guide.

continuous.unlocks: Listening for the blend aloud across the day's tries, offering the slow-then-fast model the instant a chain stalls, and keeping difficulty at the edge in the moment rather than one burst a day.
continuous.still_guide_only: Reading the face before the page is covered and choosing to end on a win stay with the guide however connected the companion is.

record_hooks.writes: which sound-chain was attempted and whether it blended or stayed separate

record_hooks.on: the guide ends the session early
record_hooks.writes: that the session was stopped on a successful moment, in the guide's words

record_hooks.on: the learner teaches the guide at the start
record_hooks.writes: that the learner opened by teaching, as a confidence signal, not a score
